# Meridian Analytics — Q3 2026 Business Report

**Period:** July 1 – September 7, 2026
**Prepared by:** Rachel Kim, VP of Sales | Claire Fontaine, CFO
**Distribution:** Executive Team

---

## Executive Summary

Q3 2026 marks another strong quarter. Across the 15-person team, **14 deals out of 22 opportunities** were closed, generating **$1,040,000** in new contract value. The pipeline remains healthy with several high-value deals pending. Critical support issues were resolved same-day in all cases.

---

## Sales Performance

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| **Total Closed Revenue** | $1,040,000 |
| **Top Region** | South ($468,000) |
| **Win Rate** | 63.6% (target: 55%) |
| **Pending Deals** | 5 deals (~$244,300) |

Product mix shifted toward **Meridian Insights Pro** (majority of closed revenue), while **Meridian DataBridge** continues as a land-and-expand vehicle with upsell opportunities maturing in Q4.

---

## Key Highlights

- **Top deal:** Sofia Delgado closed a **$198,000** Meridian Insights Pro contract (D019) on Sept 5.
- **Headcount:** 15 employees — Sales (4), Engineering (5), Product (3), HR (1), Finance (2).
- **Support SLA:** All critical-priority tickets resolved within 24 hours.
- **License utilisation:** SKU-001 (Insights Pro) at **94% capacity** — procurement review scheduled for October.

---

## Next Steps

1. Close 5 pending deals (D007, D013, D018, D020, D022) before Q3 end.
2. Begin Q4 pipeline review — target **$1.2M** in new ARR.
3. Resolve open support tickets (TKT-013, TKT-016, TKT-019) ahead of quarterly customer success calls.
4. License capacity review for SKU-001 and SKU-003 in early October.
5. HR to initiate 2 new engineering hire approvals to support Q4 roadmap.

---
